title: Extremely Lifelike Fishing
intro: Sit in a pedal-drive kayak on the open sea and fish with your own two arms. Each arm has a shoulder and an elbow on its own keys, so casting takes practice.
no_webgl: This game draws with WebGL, and this browser does not offer the version it needs. A recent Chrome, Firefox or Safari does.
how.cast: Cast: hold F, swing the rod back with I, swing it forward with K, and let go of F as the rod passes upright.
how.sink: Watch Lure depth on the left. With the bail open the lure sinks and line runs out; press Space at the depth your fish swims to close the bail.
how.work: Wind in bursts with Space, then pause. Hold E for the electric power wind: it brings the lure back at {power} m/s, a fast fish may chase it, and it stops when a fish takes the lure.
how.set: On a bite you have about {hold} s: sweep the rod up hard with I and Q together. In the scope the mouth zone ring turns green while the hook is inside it.
how.fight: Fish on: wind with Space while the ring is green; stop while it is orange or red and let the drag give line. A tired fish comes in, and it is landed once it is close.
how.scope: Hold the right mouse button for the scope: it looks at the mouth of the fish nearest the lure, and the wheel zooms up to {zoom}×.
ring.label: Tension
arms.heading: Arms
hint.cast: Hold F, swing the rod back with I, then forward with K, and let go of F.
hint.running: Line is running out; the lure is {depth} m down. Press Space to close the bail.
hint.work: Lure {depth} m down, moving {speed} m/s. Wind in bursts and pause, or hold E to power-wind.
hint.following: A {fish} is following. Pause now: most bites come as the lure stops.
hint.fight: Fish on. Wind while the ring is green; stop while it is orange or red.
event.bit: Bite. Set the hook: sweep the rod up now.
event.hook_set: Hooked a {fish}. Keep the line tight.
event.threw: The line went slack and the hook came loose.
event.jumped: It jumped. Keep the line tight.
event.snapped: The line snapped. A new lure is tied on.
landed.heading: Landed
settings.heading: Settings
settings.note: Slower arms and steady hands make casting easier. They never change how a fish behaves.
how.species: {fish}: swims {from} to {to} m down and follows a lure moving {slow} to {fast} m/s.
how.follow: A fish that follows often bites as the lure stops, so pause when the message says one is following.
hint.set: It has the lure. Set the hook now: sweep the rod up hard with I and Q.
hint.land: The {fish} is tiring. Wind it in close to land it.
